name: Freightliner eCascadia 291 kWh
source_notes: Freightliner eCascadia public spec sheet (291 kWh pack, CCS up to 350 kW). Same drivetrain as 438 kWh variant, smaller battery. Usable kWh per D-10: ~90% nameplate minus 0.5 kWh BMS reserve.

batteryHealthGuidance.notes: Same efficiency as 438 kWh variant (2.0-2.3 kWh/mi). Smaller pack → more conservative cycling recommended. 291 kWh pack supports ~155 mi typical port/drayage shift.

carbValidation.testVehicle: TransPower Class 8 drayage prototype @ 72,000 lbs GCW
carbValidation.notes: UCR chassis dynamometer + in-use study at POLB. Loaded to 72,000 lbs (average fully loaded drayage weight). EER = battery electric efficiency vs diesel.
